reason: app/models/embeddable_host.rb: the before_validation hook strips the scheme and then runs `self.host.sub!(/\/.*$/, '')`, which removes everything from the first '/' before validation runs. So the `(\/.*)?` group in `validates_format_of` (line ~3) never matches anything in practice (the spec at spec/models/embeddable_host_spec.rb shows 'https://example.com/1234/45' becoming 'example.com').
